list.text: \f[faceKris]\rHey \PN!
\f[faceKris]\rProf. Oak asked me to wait for you here.
\f[faceKris]\rThat special Pokémon he entrusted to you… how  is it going?
\f[faceKris]\rHmm… it seems your partner still has some growing to do.
\f[faceKris]\rKeep training, keep evolving, build your bond.\nWhen your Pokémon’s ready, come back.
\f[faceKris]\rOh, please put it on your party.\nI need to take a look on how  he's looking like.
\f[faceKris]\rThere’s still much to learn about Mega Evolution… and with your help, I know we’ll uncover its true potential.

Hi!
I'm an important Pokémon Fossil Researcher.\nNice to meet you.
Here I study fossil Pokémon all the time.
Do you have something for me?

then.text: Oh! That's a Pokémon fossil!
If it's in good condition this machine can revive it for you!
Let me try it.
\PN gave the Dome Fossil to the Researcher.
The fossil is in amazing condition...
This is amazing!
Everything worked well. Here it is your fossil Pokémon.
Please come backwhen you have more fossils!

else.text: No? That's ok. Come back if you have some fossil with you.
